evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS carry a real gate. scoring.toml:1-3 [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both judge.toml use aggregation='all_pass' with one binary criterion; score.py:41 gates_passed=all(score>floor) and :48 reward=0 unless gates_passed (score.py and test.sh byte-identical to frozen template; test.sh:213-221 runs gates before scored). render (gates/render/judge.toml:22-24, hro_gate_render): incorrect password leaves visitor signed out, then valid Recruiter sign-in shows 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... without a fatal error. A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' -> auth leg with positive control plus blank/static-shell exclusion. constraints (gates/constraints/judge.toml:22-24, hro_gate_shared): Recruiter creates job + candidate through ordinary UI, then an independent empty browser context signed in as Observer must find the job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' -> backing leg via successful operation + independent-context readback, matching REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. SCORED PROMPTS each restate an in-dimension gate including auth and backing legs: functional/prompt.md:9-13 ('A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'; all 43 functional criteria are type binary); polish/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives binary0 throughout'; all 5 criteria binary); visual/prompt.md:9-12 ('gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; all 5 criteria likert). No partial credit on gate failure in any dimension. SAME-ORIGIN: grep for 'origin|same-origin|cdn|external' over tests/gates and tests/scored finds no origin requirement (only an unrelated 'Rafael's board shows F where the other recruiter put it' hit); instruction.md:13 and integration.md:12-13 explicitly allow CDN assets, and no gate forbids them. PUBLIC BASIS for every gate leg: password and accounts instruction.md:17 / app_context.md:8-19; job fields title/team/hiring manager/places 1-50 hireops_rules.md:27-29; candidate name/email/source, card 'starts at the bottom of Applied' :31-32; Observer 'reads the board' :18. No hidden requirement found. WEAK-APP PROBES: static mock/SPA with canned data -> fails render ('static picture') and constraints (independent-context readback of a newly created unique record); localStorage-only app -> fails 'browser-only save'/fresh context; health-only server -> fails render; app with server-backed job but no candidate add -> 'job-only app' fails; app that creates duplicates -> 'exactly one card' fails, consistent with rules. CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBES: app requiring a team field still passes scored gates (they omit team but the judge fills required fields 'through the UI'); app with different routes/labels is fine ('Discover routes and controls by intent'); app using SSE/polling/CDN fonts not penalised; Observer as fresh-context reader is legitimate per rules :18 and alternative staff account allowed. TOOL FEASIBILITY: gates prescribe browser_run_code_unsafe new browser context with fallback 'A supported separate-context tool is an alternative'; that tool name appears in recovered judge transcripts of another workspace task (projects/patchpad-editor/jobs/.../recovered-judge-transcripts), not for this task. Minor non-blocking notes: (1) task render gate drops the template render criterion's 'no protected data is visible before sign-in' leg; anonymous refusal is graded instead in functional protocol R (functional/prompt.md:45), so the sign-in gate still has a refusal leg (wrong password) and a positive control; (2) constraints gate requires a team while scored-gate restatements omit it - not contradictory. RISK FLAG REASON: no configured judge run of either gate dimension or of the scored in-dimension gates exists for these bytes; raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent' and results/workspace.json is a scripted golden driver with API fixture setup and no gate-shaped observation (no Observer/independent-context/wrong-password entries). So the golden passing its own gates and weak-app gate discrimination are unmeasured; the source wording is correct.
